scope: Bounded EMOSA Profile-1 Search/Response with pinned native controller; discovered device entry without radio/BSS onboarding

native_source_review.finding: Response builder sets Profile 1 and Early bit, leaves kibmib_counter_supported unset; handler inserts an agent during Search processing

unit_tests.publication: Parameterized case labels hashed; outcomes/counts preserved

development_findings: Initial preflight found controller-trial.py unstaged; staged the existing helper before a run.
Run 01 timed out because controller inventory root existed before transport interface binding; added socket ownership readiness.
Run 02 failed on a missing helper import; cleanup completed; fixed before run 03.

Run 03 exposed native insertion of a discovered device during Search, contradicting the initial absence assertion. Retained as a failed development attempt; classify the entry by its zero radio/BSS inventory.

Runs 04/05 exchanged packets and observed an entry but tcpdump retained zero packets despite kernel receipt; rejected as evidence. Added immediate capture and explicit captured-Response completion barrier. Selected runs 06/07 pass independent checks.
capture_timestamps: Actual independent tcpdump timestamps, not synthetic
cleanup: Temporary namespaces/veths removed; no owned native services remain loaded after selected runs; native controller/helper shutdown aborts retained in results
